Extract per-region posterior summaries

Source: R/posterior.R
posterior_summary.Rd

Given the output of fit_bread_summary() (conjugate backend) or fit_bread_brms() (brms backend), compute the marginal posterior location / scale / credible interval of the contrast coefficient and the posterior probabilities used by classify_regions().

Usage

posterior_summary(fit, delta = 0.1, ci = 0.95)

Arguments

fit

Output of fit_bread_summary() or fit_bread_brms().

delta

Effect-size threshold on the M-value scale. Default 0.10.

ci

Credible-interval mass. Default 0.95.

Value

A data.frame with one row per region and columns: region_id, n, mean_effect, median_effect, ci_lo, ci_hi, df, scale, p_pos, p_neg, p_gt_delta, p_lt_neg_delta, error. df is NA_real_ for the empirical path.

Path selection

Each per-region fit carries either

  • $mu_n, $Lambda_n_inv, $a_n, $b_n (conjugate analytical path), in which case the marginal posterior of the contrast coefficient is a location-scale Student-t with df = 2 * a_n, or

  • $draws (brms empirical path), in which case posterior quantities are computed from the MCMC draws directly.

Columns in the returned data frame are the same in both cases.
